enchantment.malice_enhanced.lucky_hit.de: Fully charged attacks have a chance to deal double damage
enchantment.malice_enhanced.extension_of: Increases entity and block reach range
enchantment.malice_enhanced.blood_debt.d: Lower HP grants higher damage; lost HP converts to absorption
enchantment.malice_enhanced.mocking_curs: Sneaking forces nearby players to face and attack you
enchantment.malice_enhanced.recoil.desc: Knocks you back when attacking a target
Attacked entities take 2 bonus soul damage (per level)
wither_title.malice_enhanced.1.desc: Armor equals 20% of the current four-piece armor total plus 4; all damage is reduced by 20%, direct health writes by 40%
wither_title.malice_enhanced.2.desc: 30% chance to nullify projectile damage; lethal damage teleports you to your bed or respawn point, with a 60-second cooldown
wither_title.malice_enhanced.3.desc: Melee hits apply Slowness I for 3 seconds; bows, crossbows, guns and other ranged hits apply Slowness II for 2 seconds; each hit has a 20% chance to deal 5% of the target's max health as freeze damage
wither_title.malice_enhanced.4.desc: Melee or ranged hits heal 1 + 0.5% of your max health, with a 0.5-second cooldown; healing doubles below 50% health; kills heal 5% of your max health plus 5
wither_title.malice_enhanced.5.desc: Melee hits have a 20% chance to summon lightning and deal 5 + 10% of the target's current health as lightning damage; ranged hits have a 25% chance and add lightning damage equal to that hit
wither_title.malice_enhanced.6.desc: At or below 50% health, summon three Allays for 30 seconds; each heals 2 + 0.5% of your max health every second, returns within 12 blocks, and connects by a beam
wither_title.malice_enhanced.7.desc: When a bow, crossbow or similar weapon reaches its final full-charge frame, the fired projectile's initial speed is increased by 50%
wither_title.malice_enhanced.8.desc: At 100 bow-use ticks, play a chime; the projectile fired from that draw deals 500% more damage (six times damage)
wither_title.malice_enhanced.9.desc: Ranged hits have a 10% chance to create a gravity singularity, with a 2-second cooldown; radius 3 blocks, lifetime 3 seconds, pulls non-player enemies, and marked targets take ×1.15 damage
wither_title.malice_enhanced.10.desc: Bow, crossbow and other charge weapons use 50% less charge time; melee attack speed increases by 20%
wither_title.malice_enhanced.11.desc: Lethal damage is canceled, restoring 50% max health and granting max-health absorption, Regeneration V and Resistance II for 10 seconds; 60-second cooldown
wither_title.malice_enhanced.12.desc: Ranged hits or projectiles striking blocks have a 10% chance to create ball lightning, with a 1-second cooldown; at most one within 32 blocks, lasts 4 seconds and deals 2 lightning damage each second
wither_title.malice_enhanced.13.desc: All attacks ignite the target for 3 seconds; if it was already burning before the hit, that hit deals 50% more damage
advancements.malice_enhanced.wither.omen: Collect a Nether Star of every one of the thirteen titles
advancements.malice_enhanced.wither.shou: I saw an altar gathering souls, a pale blue death-light above it
advancements.malice_enhanced.wither.soul: Forge the Soul Blue Sword in the Soul Ritual
